domain-information: A Client shares their room measurements and style preferences to request a custom piece of furniture
A Client approves a design draft to confirm it matches their vision before production begins
A Furniture Designer sketches a concept and selects materials to create a detailed design plan
A Furniture Designer revises designs based on client feedback to ensure the final piece is perfect
A Carpenter cuts and assembles wood pieces to craft the furniture according to the approved design
A Carpenter finishes surfaces and applies protective coatings to enhance durability and appearance
A Quality Inspector checks the completed furniture to ensure it meets craftsmanship standards
A Quality Inspector reports any issues to the carpenter for adjustments before delivery
A Delivery Coordinator schedules transportation and handles logistics to bring furniture safely to the client
A Delivery Coordinator confirms delivery with the client and collects feedback to close the project

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: person requesting a custom furniture piece

domain objects.name: Piece Request
domain objects.description: initial request describing what furniture the client wants

domain objects.name: Design Draft
domain objects.description: early visual and material concept of the furniture

domain objects.name: Material
domain objects.description: selected materials to be used in the furniture

domain objects.name: Furniture Designer
domain objects.description: professional who creates and refines the design

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: client’s notes to adjust or approve work

domain objects.name: Quality Inspector
domain objects.description: person responsible for checking quality standards

domain objects.name: Standard Check
domain objects.description: quality review of the finished piece

domain objects.name: Issue Report
domain objects.description: notes on problems found during inspection

domain objects.name: Delivery
domain objects.description: transport of the finished furniture to the client

associations.description: Piece Request is passed to the Furniture Designer
Furniture Designer creates the Design Draft
Design Draft is aligned with the Piece Request
Feedback is used by the Furniture Designer
Furniture Designer produces the Final Design
Final Design is forwarded to Carpenter
Furniture Assembly results in the Furniture Piece
Quality Inspector performs the Standard Check
Standard Check evaluates the Furniture Piece
Quality Inspector creates an Issue Report
Issue Report is sent to the Carpenter
Feedback is shared with the Delivery Coordinator
